disclosure: Diagnostic only — not a published SLO.
interpretation: INDEX BISECT: no-index 141694 ≈ full 135610 ops/s (ratio 1.04×) — dual-index publish is NOT the killer; **data cooking** (encode/append/Blake+copy + write) dominates.
DISK BISECT: Discard 165940 / DevNull 158711 / Real 135610 ops/s — partial OS cost (Real/Discard=0.82×).
Raw /dev/null 3713274 vs raw work-file 963681 ops/s — pure write_all media delta without Residiuum.
Buffered put is 47% of pure-Blake ops/s — Blake-scale cost may matter.
Memory 1047216 → Discard-Buffered 165940 → Real-Buffered 135610: gap Memory→Discard is **pre-disk store work**; Discard→Real is **tail I/O**.
Raw write_all 963681 ops/s vs Buffered put 135610 — store adds 7.1× wall vs raw same-size writes.
Note: long peer multi-seal runs can still add seal_rotate wall; this micro uses 512MiB seal so mid seals are off.
